eligibility.title: Eligibility check
eligibility.action: For Point System Round 18, verify age 18–39 (DOB 1986-07-03 through 2008-07-02), health/communicable-disease fitness, no color blindness, legal/criminal/travel conditions, no Korea deportation/refusal/illegal-law history, no drug history, and total prior E-9/E-10 stay under 5 years.

registration.title: Official online registration
registration.action: Round 18 registration was accepted online through the official TOEA channel from 2026-07-02 through 2026-07-06. The window is closed.

exam_fee.title: EPS-TOPIK / Point System fee
exam_fee.action: Official Round 18 application fee: 960 THB, payable through the designated Krungthai Bank payment channel within the official window.

biometric.title: Identity / anti-fraud verification
biometric.action: Follow the identity-verification requirements in the assigned Round 18 test notice. KEP does not infer extra biometric rules beyond the current official instructions.

document_verify.title: Registration data verification
document_verify.action: Submit the electronic application only once and ensure identity/contact data are correct before final submission. Exact upload/document specifications are not asserted until a current official detailed notice is reviewed.

exam_card.title: Exam eligibility / test notice
exam_card.action: DOE planned to publish the Korean-test eligible list on 2026-08-10. Use the official DOE/EPS Thailand notice for the assigned venue and test session.

eps_topik.title: EPS-TOPIK — Round 1
eps_topik.action: Round 18 is a Point System selection. Use only the current official exam notice for the exact Manufacturing test schedule and result; do not reuse Special EPS-TOPIK dates.

skill_competency.title: Skills Test — Round 2
skill_competency.action: DOE stated that the list of candidates eligible for the skills test would be announced on 2026-10-19. As of this KEP check, that date has not yet arrived; do not pre-promote a skills result or schedule.

final_selection.title: Point-based final selection
final_selection.action: Passing the Korean and skills stages does not guarantee employer selection. Final candidate status must follow the current official Point System result notice.

psychology_pre_job.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
psychology_pre_job.action: No separate Thailand psychology step is asserted from the verified Round 18 recruitment notice. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology requirements.

mcu1.title: Medical examination
mcu1.action: Health fitness is an eligibility condition, but KEP has not yet promoted the exact current Round 18 post-selection medical provider/checklist. Follow the current DOE notice when issued.

job_application.title: Employment-candidate file
job_application.action: Only follow the current DOE/TOEA instruction for the candidate-file stage after Point System selection. Exact Round 18 documents and timing remain under review.

roster.title: EPS candidate roster
roster.action: Approved candidates are proposed for Korean employer selection through the official EPS process. No private intermediary can guarantee roster priority.

employer_selection.title: Korean employer selection
employer_selection.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS system. Passing the tests or appearing on the roster does not guarantee employer selection.

slc.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
slc.action: If selected by a Korean employer, follow the current DOE/EPS notice for SLC review/signing and next steps. Do not pay a broker to obtain or alter an SLC.

post_slc_requirements.title: Post-SLC Thailand requirements
post_slc_requirements.action: Follow only current DOE instructions for training, medical follow-up, visa documents, payments and departure preparation. Older or Special EPS instructions are not current Regular Round 18 rules.

visa_docs.title: Visa document package
visa_docs.action: Use the current DOE/Korean-mission visa notice. Exact Round 18 Manufacturing visa checklist and charges are not yet mapped in KEP.

predeparture_training.title: Pre-departure training
predeparture_training.action: Complete only the official pre-departure training assigned by DOE. Exact Round 18 cohort timing/fees remain notice-specific.

mcu3_departure.title: Final health/departure readiness
mcu3_departure.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow the current Thailand departure notice if a final medical or screening step is explicitly required.

departure.title: Official departure
departure.action: Travel only after the official EPS contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete and DOE issues the applicable departure instructions.

korea_entry_training.title: Korea entry + employment education
korea_entry_training.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

employer_handover.title: Employer handover
employer_handover.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

residence_registration.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
residence_registration.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

eps_insurance_check.title: EPS insurance check
eps_insurance_check.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

first_payroll_check.title: First payroll check
first_payroll_check.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

labor_support_ready.title: Labor support readiness
labor_support_ready.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

employment_maintenance.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
employment_maintenance.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
